title: Persona
description: Describes an actor — internal or external — who interacts with one or more bank capabilities.

id.description: Unique persona identifier in the form PER-XXX.

type.description: Whether the persona is an employee / system operator (internal) or a customer, partner, or third party (external).

description.description: Concise narrative of who this persona is and what they need from the bank's capabilities.

capability_touchpoints.description: Ordered list of capability or sub-capability IDs (CAP-XXX or CAP-XXX.YY) that this persona interacts with.

access_classification.description: Minimum access tier required: public (no auth), authenticated (identity verified), privileged (role-gated sensitive data), administrative (platform-level control).

channels.description: Interaction channels available to this persona.

frequency.description: Typical interaction cadence for this persona.

volume_estimate.description: Qualitative or quantitative description of the population size or transaction volume for this persona.
